description: This Java class 'DefaultPersistenceConfig' provides a default implementation for configuring persistence settings related to health checks in a service. It includes methods for creating instances from a configuration object, and accessor methods for configuration properties such as 'enabled', 'timeout', and 'metricsReporterConfig'. It also overrides 'equals', 'hashCode', and 'toString'.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceConfig
classes.description: Final class implementing PersistenceConfig, encapsulating persistence-related configuration options such as enabled status, timeout, and metrics reporter configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DefaultPersistenceConfig instance from a Config object, using configuration fallback logic.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether persistence is enabled based on configuration.
